money
錢
How do you decide what to do with unexpected extra money?
I would set some money aside before buying anything. Then I could choose one useful purchase without spending the whole amount.
我會先留下一部分錢，再考慮買東西。剩下的挑一樣實用品，不必一次花光。
price
價格
When would you pay a higher price for an everyday item?
I would pay a higher price for shoes that last and feel comfortable. Replacing a poor pair repeatedly could cost more.
耐穿又舒服的鞋子，我願意接受高一點的價格。一直換不好穿的鞋，可能反而更花錢。
cost
費用
What hidden cost would you check before booking a cheap holiday?
I would check the cost of reaching the airport and carrying luggage. A low ticket price might not reflect the total expense.
我會先查去機場和托運行李的費用。票價低，不代表整趟花費就少。
value
價值
What makes a purchase good value rather than simply cheap?
Good value means something meets a real need and lasts. A cheap object I never use would still waste money.
真正有價值的東西，要用得到也耐用。買得再便宜卻一直沒用，還是浪費錢。
afford
負擔得起
Friends suggest an outing you cannot afford. What would you say?
I would explain that I cannot afford that plan right now. I could suggest a cheaper activity rather than avoid them without explanation.
我會坦白說，這次行程的花費超過自己負擔得起的範圍。也會提議便宜一點的活動，不無故躲著他們。
save
存錢
What would help you save for something that takes several months?
I would save a manageable amount on a regular date. Keeping the goal visible would remind me why I was waiting.
我會固定日期存錢，金額以做得到為主。把目標放在看得到的地方，也能提醒自己為什麼要等。
spend
花
How would you decide whether to spend money on a new hobby?
I would spend a little on a trial first. Borrowing equipment would let me explore the hobby before buying everything.
我會先花少量的錢試試。借器材來體驗，就不用一開始把所有東西都買齊。
expense
開支
Which recurring expense would you reconsider if your budget became tighter?
I would review an expense such as an unused subscription. Cancelling something I rarely use would affect my life less than cutting essentials.
我會先檢查不常用的訂閱這類開支。取消很少用的服務，比刪掉生活必需品影響小。
income
收入
If your income from a part-time job changed each month, how would you plan your spending?
I would plan my spending based on my lowest monthly income. In better months, I would save the extra money instead of spending it right away.
我會用收入最少的月份來規劃花費。收入比較多的月份，就把多出來的錢存起來，不馬上花掉。
discount
折扣
How do you decide whether a discount is worth using?
I check whether I wanted the item before seeing the discount. Saving money on something unnecessary is not really a saving.
我會先想，沒看到折扣之前是不是也需要它。買不必要的東西，便宜了也不算省。
bargain
划算
A second-hand item looks like a bargain. What would you check?
I would check its condition before calling it a bargain. Missing parts or repairs might make the final cost much higher.
我會先檢查狀況，再判斷是不是划算。少零件或需要維修，都可能讓最後花費增加。
purchase
購買
When would you delay a purchase even though you could pay for it?
I would delay a large purchase if I had not compared the options. Waiting a few days could clarify whether I genuinely needed it.
還沒比較選項前，我會延後大額購買。等幾天，可能更清楚自己是不是真的需要。
receipt
收據
What do you usually do with the receipt after buying something expensive, like headphones?
I keep the receipt in case I need to return the headphones. I also take a photo of it so I can still find the details if the paper fades.
我會留著收據，以防耳機需要退貨。也會拍張照，就算紙上的字褪色了，還是找得到購買資料。
refund
退款
How would you request a refund for an item that arrived damaged?
I would request a refund with clear photos of the damage. Including the order details would help the seller investigate quickly.
我會附上清楚的損壞照片申請退款。也提供訂單資料，讓賣家比較快查明。
borrow
借用
What would you clarify before you borrow something valuable from a friend?
Before I borrow it, I would agree on a return date. I would also ask how to handle any accidental damage.
借用貴重物品前，我會先說好歸還日期。也問清楚，如果不小心弄壞該怎麼處理。
lend
借
How would you respond if a friend asked you to lend more than you felt comfortable with?
I would not lend more than I could comfortably manage. I would explain my limit clearly rather than make a promise I might regret.
超過自己能接受的範圍，我就不會借。我會清楚說明界線，不勉強答應又後悔。
debt
債務
What would you tell a friend who wants to borrow money to buy an expensive new phone?
I would tell my friend to think carefully before going into debt for a phone. Paying it back could take months, and an older model might work just as well.
我會叫朋友在為了手機背上債務之前，先好好想清楚。還錢可能要好幾個月，舊一點的機型說不定也很好用。
loan
貸款
If you needed a student loan for university, what would you want to know first?
I would want to know how much interest the loan charges and when I have to start paying it back. I would also ask what happens if I cannot find a job right away.
我會想知道這筆就學貸款利息多少、什麼時候開始還。也會問如果畢業後沒馬上找到工作，該怎麼辦。
investment
投入
What investment of time has been worthwhile for you?
Learning to cook was a worthwhile investment of time. I now spend less on takeout and enjoy meals I can adjust myself.
花時間學煮飯，是很值得的投入。現在外食費少了，也能煮出自己喜歡的口味。
insurance
保險
What would you check before choosing travel insurance?
I would check what the insurance covers and what it excludes. I would also read how to request help during the trip.
我會先看保險的保障和除外項目。也讀清楚，旅途中需要協助時要怎麼聯絡。
financial
財務
Your class wants to save for a graduation trip. How would you plan this financial goal together?
We would first agree on how much the trip will cost and how much each person can pay. Then someone would keep simple records so our financial plan stays clear to everyone.
我們會先確認旅行要花多少錢、每個人能出多少。再請一個人簡單記帳，讓大家都清楚這個財務計畫。
emergency
緊急狀況
What would you always carry with you in case of an emergency?
In case of an emergency, I keep my parents' phone numbers on a card in my wallet. If my phone died, I could still contact them.
為了以防緊急狀況，我會把爸媽的電話寫在小卡上放在錢包裡。就算手機沒電，也還能聯絡到他們。
profit
利潤
A small shop sells more products but earns less profit. What might you investigate?
I would compare the profit per item with rising costs. More sales might not help if discounts and delivery fees absorbed the difference.
我會比較每件商品的利潤和增加的成本。如果折扣、運費吃掉差額，賣多也未必賺多。
risk
風險
How would you respond to an offer promising easy money with little risk?
I would question the claim that there was little risk. I would want independent information and time to consider it without pressure.
我會懷疑幾乎沒有風險的說法。先找獨立資訊，也需要不被催促的時間好好考慮。
